proposals.evidence: Turner duhitṛ explicitly cites Phalura dhī, Torwali dhū, Khowar žūr, Kalasha jhūr/chū and the eastern jhi/jhiu/zī/zīw forms. These survey responses fit those exact regional branches, including the Kalasha paired response whose two alternatives remain in one family. Turner retains uncertainty about the origin of the palatal initial in some daughter forms.
